strings.privacy.title: Tinfaliyin
strings.privacy.description: Mek issefti pdffusion isɣzaf n k: ur yelli uziṭṭaf, ur yelli usɣzaf ittuṭṭfen, ur yelli imnayen d usnegmi n isefka.
strings.privacy.intro: pdffusion ittwanfa afad isɣzaf n k ad qqnen i kecc. Dagi, s wawal aɣezfan, acu iyeḍran mi tesseqdadeḍ.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Isɣzaf n k
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ttwazznan s ubaɛuḍ (HTTPS), ttwaskarn s wudm awurman, sakin ttwkkasn zund tura mi tewjed tawuri. Isɣzaf imeqqranen tteddun s usenɣms anawur s yisem amazzal d ttwkkasn zund tura mi tkfa twuri; asgaddud awurman yekkes kra illan deg 24 n wussan.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Ur yelli uziṭṭaf, ur yelli isefka n wiyyaḍ
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdffusion ur yessuter uziṭṭaf, ur yelli tansa n imayl d ur yelli tayssa n ubutun. Isɣzaf n k ur ttwaraɛen, ur ttwazrawen, ur ttwazznan neɣ ur ttwseqdaden ad snernin tasnatnawt.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Asɣel n imnayen
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Nettagi ismlal s wudm amggan d bla ikukiyen (Vercel Web Analytics) afad ad nessen anwi imassen iyesseftrn. Ur yelli imnayen, ur yelli uḍfaṛ.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Ikukiyen
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Akuki yan, yezmer ad yili: ittmekta taseklant tferneḍ.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Aselkim
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Asmel ittwasegma s Vercel deg iselkimn n Paris; isenfalen n Word, Excel d PowerPoint ttwasegman s Render deg Frankfurt. Imeskar ad tesseqdaden isɣzaf ɣas deg wakud n usenfel.

strings.legal.terms.description: pdffusion d ilelli i yal yiwen, daɣen tiwsatin d unabaḍ. Ifayluwen-inek qqaren-d inek: ulac win yettwaznen neɣ yettwaḥerzen.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Tiwtilin-ayi ttwabeddent aseqdec inek n pdffusion. Ttwabeddent s wudem usrid daɣen s tutlayt taḥeqqit. S useqdec n usmel, tqebleḍ-tent.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Anwa ara yesnulfulen pdffusion
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdffusion yettwasebded, yettwagna daɣen yettwazgel sɣur Mikailou Cedric Toure, ameskar yellan deg New Brunswick, Kanada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Turagt tilellit n useqdec, i yal yiwen
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdffusion d ilelli, war akles daɣen war azemz n wakud, i yal yiwen: imdanen, inelmaden, isdawanen, tiwsatin, tiwsatin war lbaṭṭel, tiwnafutin d unabaḍ, deg Kanada d yal tamurt nniḍen. Ulac aseqdec yettwakksen i unagraw aɣaman, aximbang ulac. Ifayluwen tssufuɣeḍ d inek akk: ur sɛin ara tamatart n waman neɣ isem n pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Yal ifayluwen-inek, daɣen wid n sirr
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Tzemreḍ ad tesnekdeḍ yal anaw n ufaylu, daɣen wid n sirr, aximbang pdffusion ur yeɣri ara, ur yesnekd ara, ur yeḥriz ara neɣ ur yesfkay ara ifayluwen-inek: ttwasegman s wudem awurman sakin ttwakseɣ. Teqqimeḍ d bab nnsen, daɣen tessugteḍ asenqed n yizerfan yesfran akken ad ten-tesnekdeḍ.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Tangalt taẓnant d usebded ɣef yiseklan-inek
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Tangalt taẓnant n pdffusion ttwazgel ddaw turagt MIT. Tzemreḍ ad tɣriḍ-tt, ad t-tesnekdeḍ, ad t-tesbeddeḍ ɣef yiseklan-inek (daɣen deg wazun yettwazglen war azday ɣef Internet), ad t-tesnifel daɣen ad t-tesfkay warmi tesseɣsiḍ, ma tḥerzeḍ talɣa n yizerfan n usnulful d turagt.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Aseqdec yettwasebden
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Ur tzemreḍ ara ad tesqedeḍ pdffusion i twuriwin ur nelli ara n lqanun, ad tɛerḍeḍ ad txeṛbeḍ amezgun (asali awurman ameqqran, tiɛerḍin n unekcum) neɣ ad tɛeddiḍ tiwtilin-is tiẓnatin. Azal d uṭṭun n yifayluwen sbedden amezgun i yal yiwen.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Azday
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdffusion yettunefk warmi tesseɣsiḍ. Yezmir ad isnifel, ad yettwakkes i useruḥu neɣ ad yeḥbes. Ḥrez dayem ifayluwen-inek izwaran: pdffusion ur yeḥriz ara akk anɣa nnsen.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Tasegta d tallelt
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Amezgun yettunefk “akken yella”, war tasegta n waddal. S wazal yesfran s lqanun, ameskar ur yesgi ara tallelt i tɣawsiwin timawiyin, asrufu n yisefka neɣ asnulfu ur nelli ara iwata. Senked ifayluwen tssufuɣeḍ uqbel ad ten-tesqedeḍ i kra yesɛan azal.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Tazmert taẓnant
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Isem n pdffusion, tamatart-is d wawalen n usmel d wid n umeskar; tangalt tella ddaw turagt MIT akken yettwazgel deg ufella. Timatertin n yismawen (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) d tid n yibab nnsen.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Lqanun n useqdec
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Tiwtilin-ayi ttwabeddent s lqanun n Temnaḍt n New Brunswick d yilugan n unabaḍ n Kanada yellan deg-s. Tiwiziwin n New Brunswick sɛan azrf, war ma ttwakseɣ yizerfan i k-yefka lqanun n tmurt-inek d amsaɣ.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Isnifilen
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Tiwtilin-ayi tzemreḍ ad ttwassnifelt. Azemz n ufella n tesna yeskanay-d tanɣa yellan deg ufus; asnifel yettwaqbel kan i useqdec deffir ma yettwazgel.
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].title: Nermes
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].text: Isteqsi ɣef tiwtilin-ayi? Aru-d sɣur tesna n usenfaṛ:
strings.legal.security.title: Taɣellist d yisefka
strings.legal.security.description: Acu yeḍran d yifayluwen-inek ɣef pdffusion: assegmi awurman, war asneknad, tukksa n yirak, tazgelt, asikel deg Turuft, d tarrayt n usebded ɣef yiseklan-inek.
strings.legal.security.intro: Acu yeḍran d yifayluwen-inek, mani i ttwasegman d wamek ttwammaden: yettwazgel s wudem usrid, i ymdanen d yisqerdayen.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Ulac ifayluwen yettwaḥerzen
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Ifayluwen-inek ttwasegman s wudem awurman, sakin ttwakseɣ akken kan ara iliɣen neɣ ara ttwazned. Ulac anɣa, ulac abru n yisefka d ulac amazray. Asfeḍ awurman n yal ass yessefsay daɣen yal afaylu amezwar ara yeqqimen, ass n zik deg taggara.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: War asneknad
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Ulac win yeɣran ifayluwen-inek. Ur ttwazgen ara, ur ttwasegman ara, ur ttwafkay ara neɣ ur ttwaseqdent ara i usileɣ n tussna taberkant. pdffusion ur yesɛi ara ikajuten, ulac issekniyen d ulac ismawen n iseqdacen.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Tazgelt
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Yal azday yettwazgel (HTTPS) daɣen asmel yessefti tazgelt ɣef yal tirzi (HSTS). Amass n Ustan ar yesnezgel PDF-inek s AES-256; awal n uzdas i tferneḍ ur yettwaḥriz ara.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Mani i ttwasegman yifayluwen-inek
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Asmel, PDF d imassen n tugniwin: Vercel, alemmas n yisefka deg Paris (Fransa, Tadukli n Turuft). Asnifel n Word, Excel d PowerPoint: Render, deg Frankfurt (Almanya, Tadukli n Turuft). Ifayluwen izaden 4 MB: asikel amezwar n Vercel Blob, s yisem n usurif, yettwakes deffir useqdec.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Aẓeṭṭa aẓnan
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Issekniyen n taɣellist (HSTS, aɣbal n usmel ad yettwagennu deg tesniwin nniḍen, asesten mgal anawen imnuklafen n yifayluwen), tansa n yifayluwen imezwaren ur nettwassen, d umass n usnifel i iqeblen kan isutren sɛan aṛemmuz uffir. Yal asnifel n tegrurt yettwaseqdec s wudem awurman (tSEnked, asesten n wanaw) uqbel asufeɣ.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Talwit d lqanun yettwasebden
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdffusion yettwazgel deg New Brunswick daɣen yeḍfer lqanun n Kanada n Ustan n Yisefka Imdanen d Yifayluwen Imarayen (PIPEDA). Ur yesmuna ara isefka imdanen ɣef iseqdacen-is: ulac akajut, ulac tansa n imel, ulac akukis n usekni. Yettwasebded ɣef yisefran imezwaran am GDPR n Turuft d Lqanun 25 n Quebec: afra n yisefka, war asseqdec n jdid, tukksa deffir assegmi.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: I tiwsatin sɛan ilugan iɣmayan
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Ma yella ilugan-inek ttwagennun azazen n yifayluwen i umass n berra, sbedd pdffusion ɣef yiseklan-inek. Asnas ammid d ilelli, d aẓeṭṭa uffir daɣen yetteddu war azday ɣef Internet: ulac afaylu yeǧǧan aẓeṭṭa-inek. Amaway n usebded yella deg tesna n usenfaṛ.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Asedday
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Tangalt taẓnant tammit tella d taẓraf: imassanen-inek n taɣellist zemren ad senkden yal awal seg waya.
strings.legal.security.sections[8].title: Mel-d tamukrist
strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Tɣileḍ tufiḍ tamukrist n taɣellist? Mel-d s wudem uffir seg ufeggag “Taɣellist” n tesna n usenfaṛ:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Asenqed
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Tasertit n asenqed n pdffusion: iswi WCAG 2.2 azwel AA, tiwsatin yellan, tilisa tiwwussanin d wamek ara temleḍ tamukrist.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Yal yiwen yessefk ad yezmer ad iseqdec pdffusion, d imdanen ɣiwlen neɣ sɛan tafat imẓẓiyen, wid iɛewren neɣ sɛan ugur aẓan.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Aswir iswi
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdffusion iswi-s ad yeḍfer Alkanen n Asenqed n Yisens Aẓeṭṭa (WCAG) 2.2, aswir AA, azwel aɣelnaw W3C. Aswir-ayi yeswi isutren n Alkan n unabaḍ n Kanada ɣef Asenqed n Yisens Aẓeṭṭa, azwel aɣelnaw EN 301 549 d Talɣa 508 deg Marikan, yettwazen ɣef WCAG 2.0 neɣ 2.1 aswir AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Aswir n teẓri
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdffusion yeḍfer s wudem uzlig WCAG 2.2 aswir AA: tilisa tiwwussanin ttwabderen deg ufella. Tasertit-ayi tbedd ɣef usenqed agensan yettwuxdem deg 2 Ɣuct 2026, s yimassen awurmanen (axe, Lighthouse) d usenqed s ufus (amuɣ, aswir, asbuɣer, tɣuriwin). Ulac asenqed afrayan yettwuxdem i tura.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Acu yellan
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Asmel n zedɣa ikat ula s tasiwt, s tqeccirt n "Zuzr s agensu" d uzwir iban ɣef uferdis amuggar. Asirew n uḍris iga 4.5:1 s drus. Tiwwuriwin n tawwuri (asali, agmuḍ, tuccḍa) ttunefknt i iniyen n ugdil. Tigzi n ufaylu tizmiri ad tettusummad war asuruf d usfali, s usemres n tqeffalin. Asmel yeṭṭafar amhaz n uɣawas n unamek n usebrreḍ n usnas-nk: asaru iḥbes dɣa. Isniwen ttilin ttwaryaren s 400% n uzrir d ɣef tiliɣri. Tutlayt n kraygat usu nniɣen tettwabder, d Taɛrabt tettwaskn seg uyeffus s aẓelmaḍ.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Tilisa tiwwussanin
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: War asbadu-agi, isaruwen n usnifeɣ (agensu, tanzayt, ameskar n umasal) tteddun s war asgunfu; ameskar iḥbes mi tɣawsel neɣ mi d-tusi tasiwt. Tanzayt tusrit ɣef usu agejdan tettwasbedd s tmouseft neɣ s ufus; d tin n usnifeɣ, d wumuɣ n yiswiren i d-yeskaned yella daɣen d aḍris ɣef usu. Tutlayt i d-yettwatararen s umacin tizmiri ad tesɛu tiɣbula. Taneggarut, tazmirt n ussekcem n ufaylu yettuẓra teqqen ɣer umezwaru: pdffusion ur yettnerna ara tasiɣutin n uzraw i PDF ur nesɛi ti.
